name: For God's Sake, Give More Power to the People

podcast.body: This title track from their 1971 album represented a significant shift in the band's musical direction, embodying an urgency not present in their previous work. According to funk historian Ricky Vincent, the song was a direct response to the killing of Fred Hampton and served as a popular acknowledgment of the Black Panther Party's influence, drawing comparisons to Curtis Mayfield's "If There's a Hell Below, We're All Going to Go." "Much like if there's a hell below, we're all going to go by Curtis Mayfield."
